name: 砂浜の一日
description: It is a sunny beach. A big umbrella is on the left, and a bag is under it. A girl is looking far away next to the umbrella. A woman is sitting on a bench on the right. A trash bin is next to the bench. A red ball is on the sand in the center. A boy is running toward the ball. A dog is running toward the ball too.
